title: A job placed on a workstation whose executor is offline moves to the fallback its policy names, and only there
goal: A workstation executor holds the lease jobexec/<host>/<operator> while it serves; a queued job placed on a workstation whose lease has been missing for the decision's fallback_after_s is taken by an executor of the decision's fallback kind, which records a job event with the reason executor offline since T and the new placement; a decision with no fallback leaves the job queued with that reason; a live lease keeps the job on its workstation

run:
import sys,os,json,time,tempfile,subprocess,threading,http.server
class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    seen=[]; out={}
    def do_POST(s):
        n=int(s.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0); H.seen.append((s.path,json.loads(s.rfile.read(n) or b"{}")))
        b=json.dumps(H.out).encode(); s.send_response(200); s.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(b))); s.end_headers(); s.wfile.write(b)
    def log_message(s,*a): pass
srv=http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",0),H); threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever,daemon=True).start()
OPA=f"http://127.0.0.1:{srv.server_port}"
dec=lambda **k: {"result":dict({"executor":"workstation","identity":"none","fallback":None,"fallback_after_s":0,"budget_cap_usd":None,"decided_by":"default"},**k)}
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); env=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(d,"c.sqlite"))
kj=lambda *x,e=None: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbjob.py",*x],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300,env=e or env)
H.out=dec(executor="workstation",fallback="server",fallback_after_s=1)
j=json.loads(kj("submit","check","--name","backlog-check","--no-ensure","--opa",OPA).stdout)["job"]
H.out=dec(executor="workstation",fallback=None)
k=json.loads(kj("submit","check","--name","tests-changed","--no-ensure","--opa",OPA).stdout)["job"]
time.sleep(2); kj("serve","--kind","server","--data",os.path.join(d,"srv"),"--once")
a=json.loads(kj("status",j).stdout); b=json.loads(kj("status",k).stdout)
assert a["state"]!="queued" and a["placement"]["executor"]=="server" and any("offline" in (e.get("reason") or "") for e in a["events"]), a
assert b["state"]=="queued" and "offline" in (b.get("reason") or ""), b
